metadata.title: Clicked like a confused raccoon and somehow forced that 1 poor soul to uninstall? Valorant madness
metadata.description:
Just mashed buttons like I was swatting flies with a blindfold.
Enemy probably reconsidering their life choices.
Did NOT deserve that, but hey, chaos loves me right now.
If your aim’s a happy accident, welcome to the chaos club.

Tap if your aim’s more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
